score.summary: Corporate segment generates the most revenue: $210,905.52.

result.summary: Corporate segment generates the most revenue: $210,905.52.

findings.statement: Corporate segment has the highest total revenue.
findings.code: SELECT c.segment, SUM(o.order_value) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

data_quality_notes: orders: no nulls, no duplicates; customers: no nulls, no duplicates
assumptions: All orders have valid customer_id linking to customers table
limitations: Revenue calculated only from order_value; does not account for returns or discounts
